source: &738 The systems for controlling the allocation of power and security, guarded by the Mindjacker until Galatea can finish her mission.

source: &2032 I don't want to risk damaging it...

target: &743 电力系统显然成功改换了供电路径，不过那短暂的一刻，已经帮你阻止了意识劫持者。

source: &744 The power junction for this area.
